深山之中，一处偏僻破败、不知名的道观里，一口布满灰尘的棺材突然发出轻微的响动，紧接着，棺材盖“哐当”一声被猛地掀开，一个还在大口咳血、气息萎靡的老道，从棺材里坐了起来，正是那个逃脱的邪道。

如今的老道，早已没了之前的阴鸷威严，只剩下一副残破的元神了，每咳出一口血，元神就变得更加萎靡一分。

老道从棺材角落里翻出一个玉瓶，颤抖着从里面倒出一枚通体赤红的丹药，毫不犹豫地吞服了下去，这是他早就备好的后手，专门用来保命疗伤的。

丹药入口即化，一股磅礴的灵力缓缓扩散开来，滋养着他残破的元神，咳血的动作这才渐渐止住，气息也稍稍平稳了一些。

老道眼神阴鸷，死死地攥着拳头，咬牙切齿地低语：“小子，坏我道基，毁我肉身，这笔账，我们没完！！！”

道观里随即陷入一片死寂，在夜色的映衬下，透着一股说不出的诡异。

另一边，吴姜已经按捺不住心中的激动，胡乱擦了擦身子，裹上浴巾就冲回房间，刚躺上床，就迫不及待的阴魂出窍，直奔地府而去。

一等鬼差啊，不仅权限比二等鬼差大了不少，就连保底俸禄，都比以前翻了一倍，从每月一百贡献点，变成了两百贡献点。

等吴姜到了无常殿的时候，就听到里面传来阵阵嘲讽的笑声，还有黑白无常憋屈的反驳声。

吴姜悄悄探头一看，只见牛头马面正站在殿中，对着黑白无常轮番嘲讽，黑白无常已经快变成黑黑无常了。

“哈哈，我说老白、老黑，你们俩可真行啊！亲自出手，居然还能让一个邪道跑了，这要是传出去，整个地府的阴差，怕不是大牙都能笑掉了！”

“就是就是，本来是安排给我们哥俩的活儿，让你们抢，活该了吧？”

黑白无常坐在椅子上，脸色黑得像锅底，浑身散发着低气压，已经无力反驳了，毕竟这事，确实是他们理亏在先。

吴姜心里咯噔一下，坏了，来的不是时候啊！

可事已至此，他也不能转身就走，只能硬着头皮，走了进去，恭敬地躬身行礼：“属下吴姜，见过两位老大，见过牛头、马面两位大人。”

听到吴姜的声音，殿内的嘲讽声瞬间停了下来，黑白无常抬头看了他一眼，虽然脸色依旧难看，但也没有牵连他。

Deep in the mountains, in a remote, dilapidated and unknown Taoist temple, a dusty coffin suddenly made a slight noise. Then, the coffin lid was suddenly opened with a "clang", and an old Taoist who was still coughing up blood and breathless sat up from the coffin. It was the evil Taoist who escaped.

Nowadays, the old Taoist has long lost the sinister majesty of the past, and only a broken soul is left. Every time he coughs out a mouthful of blood, the soul becomes more and more sluggish.

The old Taoist took out a jade bottle from the corner of the coffin, tremblingly poured out a red pill from it, and swallowed it without hesitation. This was a back-up he had prepared long ago, specifically to save his life and heal his injuries.

The elixir melted in his mouth, and a majestic spiritual power slowly spread out, nourishing his broken soul. Only then did he cough up blood and his breathing became slightly calmer.

The old Taoist's eyes were sinister, he clenched his fists, and whispered through gritted teeth: "Boy, destroy my Taoist base and destroy my body. We will never finish this debt!!!"

The Taoist temple immediately fell into a dead silence. Against the backdrop of the night, there was an indescribable strangeness.

On the other side, Wu Jiang could no longer suppress the excitement in his heart. He wiped his body randomly, wrapped himself in a bath towel and rushed back to the room. As soon as he lay down on the bed, his ghost couldn't wait to leave his body and went straight to the underworld.

First-class ghosts not only have much greater authority than second-class ghosts, but their guaranteed salary has doubled from before, from one hundred contribution points per month to two hundred contribution points.

When Wu Jiang arrived at the Wuchang Hall, he heard bursts of mocking laughter coming from inside, as well as the frustrated retorts of Black and White Wuchang.

Wu Jiang quietly peeked out and saw a bull-headed horse standing in the hall, mocking the black and white impermanence in turn. The black and white impermanence was about to turn into the black and black impermanence.

"Haha, I'm talking about Lao Bai and Lao Hei, you two are so good! You can actually let an evil spirit escape by taking action in person. If this spreads out, I'm afraid even Da Ya will laugh out loud about the evil deeds in the entire underworld!"

"That's right, it was originally assigned to us brothers, but you guys deserve it, right?"

Black and white Wuchang sat on the chair, his face as dark as the bottom of a pot, and his whole body exuded low pressure. He was unable to refute. After all, they were indeed at fault in this matter.

Wu Jiang's heart skipped a beat, it was bad, it came at the wrong time!

But now that the matter was over, he couldn't turn around and leave. He could only bite the bullet, walked in, and bowed respectfully: "My subordinate Wu Jiang, I have met the two bosses, and the two adults, Niutou and Horseface."

Hearing Wu Jiang's voice, the taunts in the palace stopped instantly. Black and White Wuchang raised his head and glanced at him. Although his face was still ugly, he did not implicate him.
